devdoc.details: Manages the lifecycle and access control for NFTs used in a managed strategy, leveraging governance and escrow functionalities.      This contract serves as the central point for managing NFTs, their attachments to strategies, and authorized user interactions.

AccessDenied().details: Error indicating an unauthorized access attempt.

AlreadyAttached().details: Error indicating an attempt to reattach an NFT that is already attached to a managed token.

params.value: The duration (in seconds) that was requested to be set.

IncorrectUserNFT().details: Error indicating a mismatch or incorrect association between user NFTs and managed tokens.

ManagedNFTIsDisabled().details: Error indicating an operation attempted on a managed NFT that is currently disabled.

NotAttached().details: Error indicating that a required attachment action was not found or is missing.

NotManagedNFT().details: Error indicating that the specified token ID does not correspond to a managed NFT.

CreateManagedNFT(address,address,uint256.details: Emitted when a new managed NFT is created and attached to a strategy.

params.sender: The address that performed the creation.
params.strategy: The address of the strategy to which the NFT is attached.
params.tokenId: The ID of the newly created managed NFT.

Initialized(uint8).details: Triggered when the contract has been initialized or reinitialized.

RoleAdminChanged(bytes32,bytes32,bytes32.details: Emitted when `newAdminRole` is set as ``role``'s admin role, replacing `previousAdminRole` `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` is the starting admin for all roles, despite {RoleAdminChanged} not being emitted signaling this. _Available since v3.1._

RoleGranted(bytes32,address,address).details: Emitted when `account` is granted `role`. `sender` is the account that originated the contract call, an admin role bearer except when using {AccessControl-_setupRole}.

RoleRevoked(bytes32,address,address).details: Emitted when `account` is revoked `role`. `sender` is the account that originated the contract call:   - if using `revokeRole`, it is the admin role bearer   - if using `renounceRole`, it is the role bearer (i.e. `account`)

SetAuthorizedUser(uint256,address).details: Emitted when an authorized user is set for a managed NFT.

params.managedTokenId: The ID of the managed NFT.

SetStrategyFlags(address,uint8).details: Emitted when the strategy flags for a specific strategy are updated.

params.flags: The new set of flags assigned to the strategy.
params.strategy: The address of the strategy whose flags are being updated.

SetWhitelistedNFT(uint256,bool).details: Emitted when an NFT is whitelisted or removed from the whitelist.

params.isWhitelisted: True if the NFT is being whitelisted, false if it is being removed from the whitelist.
params.tokenId: The ID of the NFT being modified.

ToggleDisableManagedNFT(address,uint256,.details: Emitted when the disabled state of a managed NFT is toggled.

params.isDisable: True if the NFT is now disabled, false if it is enabled.
params.sender: The address that triggered the state change.
params.tokenId: The ID of the managed NFT affected.

constructor.details: Constructor that disables initialization on implementation.

params.strategy_: The strategy to which the managed NFT will be attached

getAttachedManagedTokenId(uint256).details: Returns the managed token ID to which the user's NFT is currently attached.

params.tokenId_: The token ID of the user's NFT.

returns._0: The ID of the managed token to which the NFT is attached.

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

params.voter_: The address of the voter contract
params.votingEscrow_: The address of the voting escrow contract

isAdmin(address).details: Determines whether an address holds the MANAGED_NFT_ADMIN role, granting administrative capabilities.

params.account_: The address to check for administrative privileges.

returns._0: True if the address has administrative privileges, false otherwise.

isAttachedNFT(uint256).details: Returns true if the user's NFT is attached to any managed token.

params.tokenId_: The token ID of the user's NFT.

returns._0: True if the NFT is attached, false otherwise.

isAuthorized(uint256,address).details: Determines whether an address is the designated authorized user for a managed token.

params.managedTokenId_: The ID of the managed token.

returns._0: True if the address is authorized, false otherwise.

isDisabledNFT(uint256).details: Checks the disabled status of a managed token to prevent operations during maintenance or shutdown periods.

params.managedTokenId_: The ID of the managed token.

returns._0: True if the managed token is disabled, false otherwise.

isManagedNFT(uint256).details: Checks the management status of a token ID to validate its inclusion in managed operations.

params.managedTokenId_: The ID of the token to check.

returns._0: True if the token is a managed NFT, false otherwise.

params.managedTokenId_: The managed token ID to attach to
params.tokenId_: The token ID of the user's NFT

onDepositToAttachedNFT(uint256,uint256).custom:error: IncorrectUserNFT Thrown if the provided token ID is not attached or if it is a managed token itself.ManagedNFTIsDisabled Thrown if the managed token is currently disabled.
onDepositToAttachedNFT(uint256,uint256).details: Called by the Voting Escrow contract when tokens are deposited to an NFT that is attached to a managed NFT.      The function verifies the token is attached, checks if it is disabled, and updates the token's state.

params.amount_: The amount of tokens to deposit.
params.tokenId_: The token ID of the user's NFT.
The token ID of the user's NFT

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `account`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

setDefaultDetachmentLockDuration(uint256.details: - The new duration must not exceed {MAX_DETACHMENT_LOCK_DURATION}. - Updates the public state variable {defaultDetachmentLockDuration}. - Emits {SetDefaultDetachmentLockDuration} on success.

params.newDuration_: The new default lock duration, in seconds.

setStrategyFlags(address,uint8).custom:emits: SetStrategyFlags - When the strategy flags are updated, this event is emitted with the new flags and the strategy address.
setStrategyFlags(address,uint8).custom:requirements: - The caller must have the `MANAGED_NFT_ADMIN` role.
setStrategyFlags(address,uint8).details: Sets the flags for the given strategy and emits the `SetStrategyFlags` event.      This function can only be called by an account with the `MANAGED_NFT_ADMIN` role.

params.flags_: The new flags to assign to the strategy.
params.strategy_: The address of the strategy to update.

params.tokenId_: The token ID of the NFT

toggleDisableManagedNFT(uint256).details: Enables or disables a managed token to control its operational status, with an event emitted for state change.

params.managedTokenId_: The ID of the managed token to toggle

MANAGED_NFT_ADMIN.details: Role identifier for administrative functions within the NFT management context.

_MAX_DETACHMENT_LOCK_DURATION.details: Used as a hard cap in {setDefaultDetachmentLockDuration}.

__gap.details: This empty reserved space is put in place to allow future versions to add new variables without shifting down storage in the inheritance chain. See https://docs.openzeppelin.com/contracts/4.x/upgradeable#storage_gaps

defaultDetachmentLockDuration.details: Strategies should read this value as the baseline window unless an explicit per-strategy override applies.

defaultDetachmentLockDuration().notice: Default duration (in seconds) of the lock window that prevents detaching/withdrawing after epoch start.

initialize(address,address).notice: Initializes the Managed NFT Manager contract

isAdmin(address).notice: Checks if a given address has administrative privileges.

isAttachedNFT(uint256).notice: Checks if a specific user NFT is currently attached to a managed token.

isAuthorized(uint256,address).notice: Checks if a user is authorized to interact with a specific managed token.

isDisabledNFT(uint256).notice: Determines if a managed token is currently disabled.

isManagedNFT(uint256).notice: Determines if a token ID corresponds to a managed NFT within the system.

isWhitelistedNFT(uint256).notice: Tracks whitelisting status of NFTs to control their eligibility within the system.

managedTokensInfo(uint256).notice: Maintains management state for managed tokens.

onAttachToManagedNFT(uint256,uint256).notice: Handler for attaching to a managed NFT

onDepositToAttachedNFT(uint256,uint256).notice: Handles the deposit of tokens to an NFT attached to a managed token.

onDettachFromManagedNFT(uint256).notice: Handler for detaching from a managed NFT

setAuthorizedUser(uint256,address).notice: Authorizes a user for a specific managed token ID

setDefaultDetachmentLockDuration(uint256.notice: Set the default duration (in seconds) of the detachment/withdrawal lock window for strategies.

setStrategyFlags(address,uint8).notice: Updates the strategy flags for a specific strategy.

setWhitelistedNFT(uint256,bool).notice: Sets or unsets an NFT as whitelisted

toggleDisableManagedNFT(uint256).notice: Toggles the disabled state of a managed NFT

tokensInfo(uint256).notice: Tracks detailed information about individual tokens.
